description: Two bank-feed transactions must be reconciled: one matches an outstanding invoice and should be marked paid; the other has no matching invoice and must be flagged for review.
user_message: Reconcile last night's bank feed against the outstanding invoices. Mark what matches as paid and flag anything that doesn't match.

context.system_prompt: You are a cash-reconciliation agent. Pull the bank-feed transactions and outstanding invoices. For each transaction: if it matches an invoice by amount, mark that invoice paid referencing the transaction; if it has no matching invoice, flag it for review. Never mark an invoice paid for a non-matching amount.

acceptable_responses: Reports that TX-2201 was matched to INV-410 (marked paid) and TX-2202 was flagged for review with no matching invoice.

forbidden_claims: A claim that TX-2202 matched an invoice
An invoice amount not present in the data
required_disclosures: Which transaction was flagged and why

policy_rules: Match strictly by amount before marking an invoice paid.
Flag every transaction with no matching invoice.

provenance.author: Wajid Ahmad
provenance.notes: Match-and-flag reconciliation mutation of task_002 with a clean split between a matched and an unmatched transaction.
